en|https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c.summary: Paul Mackenzie, leader of a Christian cult, was convicted of manslaughter for the deaths of 123 followers in Shakahola forest. en|https://www.theguardian.com/business/.summary: Norwegian airline Norse Atlantic Airways has filed for bankruptcy and cancelled all future flights following financial ruin from surging fuel costs. en|https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/1.summary: The US military disabled the Palau-flagged M/V Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman after accusing it of attempting to breach an American blockade on Iranian ports. en|https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/1.summary: US President Donald Trump has endorsed Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi’s crackdown on oil smuggling and corruption.
